cuts.placeText: a macrame craft studio — hanging knotted wall pieces, coils of colored cord, a wooden dowel rack and a worktable
cuts.scene: she is a master knot crafter standing at the worktable pulling an intricate knot tight
cuts.outfit: a knot crafter look fitted to her body — a fitted cropped knit top and short wrap skirt with cord belts, bare midriff and legs, a patterned cord bracelet
